_readme: Edit this file for your team, then run: node scripts/sync-config.js (firebase deploy runs it for you). Text in {braces} fills in automatically.

brand.name: Send Your Strength
brand.tagline: Pick a day. Send a message. Help build the athlete.

lines.note: Your words can carry {obj} through the hard days.
lines.thanks: One message. One moment. One stronger athlete.
lines.standings: Be part of the work behind the wins.

team.name: Tomahawk Girls Wrestling
team.scheduleSource: the Great Northern Conference and WIAA calendars; dates being confirmed with the coaches

reward.name: Hatchet Backer
reward.text: Sponsor 5 practices or 1 meet for the same wrestler and you're a Hatchet Backer, with a handwritten thank-you from her.

payNote: Every dollar goes to Tomahawk Hatchets girls wrestling.

copy.defaultAsk:
Hi, it's {first}!

This season I'm wrestling for the Hatchets and chasing the best version of me: in the practice room, on the mat, and in the classroom. Wrestling is hard, and some mornings it's just me and the mat.

Will you sponsor one of my days? Even one {practice} practice makes a difference. A meet is {meet}.

Here's the part I love: leave me a note. I'll open it the morning of your day, and on the tough days, your words will keep me going.

No pressure at all. Thank you for being in my corner!
copy.shareText:
Hi! It's {first}. I'm wrestling for the Tomahawk Hatchets this winter and raising money for our team. You can sponsor one of my practices ({practice}) or a meet ({meet}) and leave me a note I'll open that morning. Here's my calendar: {link}
It would mean a lot. Thank you!
